name: 2026-2027 Biennial State Budget
description: A comprehensive $66 billion budget that maintained funding for universal school meals and paid leave while increasing investments in rural EMS and housing.
author: Rep. Liz Olson / Sen. John Marty

name: Infrastructure & Water Bonding Bill
description: A $700 million capital investment package focused heavily on local water/sewer infrastructure ($176M) and road/bridge repairs ($78M).
author: Rep. Fue Lee / Sen. Sandra Pappas

name: Emergency Medical Services (EMS) Relief
description: Established the new Office of Emergency Management Services and provided $27.5 million in emergency aid to struggling rural ambulance services.
author: Rep. John Huot / Sen. Judy Seeberger

name: Worker Protection Policy Update
description: Updated the 'Earned Sick and Safe Time' laws and mandated 15-minute paid rest breaks for every 4 hours worked.
author: Rep. Kristina Murphy / Sen. Erin Murphy

name: Medical Malpractice Statute Reform
description: Decreased the statute of limitations for medical malpractice claims to align Minnesota with neighboring states' standards.
author: Rep. Kelly Moller / Sen. Ron Latz

name: Protect Reproductive Options (PRO) Act
description: Codified the fundamental right to reproductive freedom, including abortion and contraception, into Minnesota state law.
author: Rep. Carlie Kotyza-Witthuhn / Sen. Jennifer McEwen

name: Universal Free School Meals
description: Provides state-funded breakfast and lunch to all K-12 students in Minnesota, regardless of family income.
author: Rep. Sydney Jordan / Sen. Heather Gustafson

name: 100% Clean Energy by 2040
description: Requires Minnesota utilities to transition to 100% carbon-free electricity by the year 2040.
author: Rep. Jamie Long / Sen. Nick Frentz

name: Restore the Vote Act
description: Restored voting rights to individuals convicted of a felony immediately upon their release from incarceration, rather than waiting until the end of parole.
author: Rep. Cedrick Frazier / Sen. Bobby Joe Champion

name: Trans Refuge Act
description: Protects individuals seeking or providing gender-affirming healthcare in Minnesota from legal action or subpoenas from other states.
author: Rep. Leigh Finke / Sen. Erin Maye Quade

name: Paid Family and Medical Leave
description: Established a statewide insurance program providing up to 12 weeks of paid leave for serious health conditions or caring for a new child or family member.
author: Rep. Ruth Richardson / Sen. Alice Mann

name: Minnesota Voting Rights Act
description: Strengthens protections against voter suppression and vote dilution at the state level following federal court rollbacks of the 1965 Voting Rights Act.
author: Rep. Emma Greenman / Sen. Bobby Joe Champion

name: Grain Indemnity Fund Establishment
description: Created a state-backed $10 million fund to protect farmers from financial loss if a grain elevator goes bankrupt. This ensures farmers are paid for their crops even if the buyer fails.
author: Rep. Samantha Vang / Sen. Aric Putnam

name: Emergency Medical Services (EMS) Rural Aid
description: Allocated $24 million in emergency one-time aid to volunteer and rural ambulance services facing budget shortfalls, plus $6 million for rural life-support pilot programs.
author: Rep. John Huot / Sen. Judy Seeberger

name: Border-to-Border Broadband Expansion
description: Appropriated $100M+ to expand high-speed internet to unserved rural areas, increasing the state's cost-share to 90% for the most remote 'low-density' locations.
author: Rep. Kristi Pursell / Sen. Aric Putnam

name: Soil Health Financial Assistance Program
description: Provides grants of up to $50,000 for farmers to purchase or retrofit specialized equipment (like no-till drills) that improves soil health and reduces long-term fertilizer costs.
author: Rep. Samantha Vang / Sen. Aric Putnam

name: Beginning Farmer Down Payment Assistance
description: Increased funding for a program providing up to $15,000 in direct grants to help new farmers, veterans, and emerging farmers buy their first parcel of farmland.
author: Rep. Samantha Vang / Sen. Aric Putnam
